description: `minDispESTNU` makes an extended dispatchable network of a simple temporal network with uncertainty (STNU) smaller. Its input comes from Morris's dispatchable variant and has ordinary edges plus *waits*, which tell a point to wait a given time unless an uncertain duration has already ended. The algorithm adds *stand-in* edges that every outcome implies, filters dominated ordinary edges, and then removes the stand-ins and each wait that an ordinary path or another wait implies. `temporal-control` leaves out the paper's diamond stand-ins, because its executor does not propagate along waits. So the result is smaller than Morris's but not proven minimal, and only simulation shows that it is dispatchable.

papers.title: Converting Simple Temporal Networks with Uncertainty into Minimal Equivalent Dispatchable Form
